cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the overseas job or open the shop with me. I taught you to put names beside jobs in a plan; tell me what your 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remember the order now. Good. Staying makes it our plan; leaving makes it the encouragement you gave me before I built it alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep your name beside the opening shift. You used to say 'we' and wait for me to do the work. Are we opening together, or shall I cross your name out?

reason: Make mentor correction drive the exact interpersonal tactic and make the final line something A needs B to do or hear. Preserve legitimate B questions and material evidence rather than writing a lesson-summary ending.
